question: The Matrice 4T ASRS report proves it lost its link and crashed. What should it have done according to the manual?

intake.focus: lost link behavior (loss of control link)
intake.reason: ASRS report claims loss of link; user asks what the manual prescribes the aircraft or pilot should do

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance urges discontinuing flight and/or initiating contingency procedures after loss of control link. The DJI Matrice 4T manual describes automatic Failsafe RTH on signal loss, RTH proceeding per settings, and that RTH can be triggered in three ways, including loss of link, with RTH persisting even if signal returns. Incident reports for the Matrice 4T are unverified accounts and provide no usable evidence. The main gap is a conflict between discontinuiting flight guidance and auto-RTH behavior, plus missing step-by-step lost-link procedures, explicit RTH thresholds, and model-agnostic guidance.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states: "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft" and if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft

claims.text: Part 107 permits transfer of control of a small UAS between certificated remote pilots only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control.
claims.quote: they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control
conditions: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control

claims.text: The remote PIC must have, in that person’s physical possession and readily accessible, this certificate and personal identification during flight operations.
claims.quote: the remote PIC must have, in that person’s physical possession and readily accessible, this certificate and personal identification during flight operations

claims.text: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft

claims.text: The manual states, when the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: The manual states that after loss of signal, the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.
claims.quote: The aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings.

claims.text: The manual states the aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.

claims.text: The RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
claims.quote: the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered)

gaps.text: FAA guidance says discontinue flight after loss of control link; the DJI manual states loss of signal triggers automatic RTH.
No usable evidence found in the approved collection for DJI Matrice 4T incident reports.
Step-by-step lost-link procedures for pilots (when to initiate RTH, minimum altitude, GPS use) are not present.
Explicit thresholds or conditions for RTH initiation after loss of link are not provided.
Guidance on communication with ground station during loss of link is not provided.
Model-agnostic vs model-specific considerations for lost-link procedures are not clearly delineated.

C001.rationale: The cited passage states exactly: attempt to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

C002.rationale: The cited passage states that two or more certificated remote pilots may transfer operational control only if both are capable of maintaining VLOS without loss of control.

C003.rationale: The cited passage states the remote PIC must have, in their physical possession and readily accessible, the certificate and personal identification during flight operations.

C005.rationale: The cited passage states that loss of remote control signal will trigger Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, matching the claim.

C006.rationale: The cited passage states the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH according to the RTH settings after loss of signal, matching the claim.

C007.rationale: The cited passage says the aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored, which matches the claim.

C008.rationale: The cited passage lists three RTH triggers: user-initiated, low battery, or remote signal loss (Failsafe RTH), which matches the claim.
